Humphreys is the provenance of the supplied exercise, not an imported E theorem used as a proof premise, so no unavailable external theorem is assumed. All selected M and all N lie in P's AND closure, each N/P has its unique producer, and no unverified source or extra H is present. This is my same-author closing inspection, not independent Audit A or a claim that structural checking proves the mathematics.
